# AmirGetsJobs

> Marketing agency and AI agency in Fresno, California. SEO and AI-search visibility, AI workflow automation, web design and development, and paid advertising for home service businesses, B2B suppliers and distributors, legal practices, and medical and dental practices. Every claim measured weekly, receipts archived.

## What we do

- SEO & GEO: rank on Google, get cited by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI Overviews). We measure AI answer share weekly across six surfaces and archive every answer.
- AI Workflows: missed-call rescue, AI SMS agents that qualify leads, estimate automation, order automation.
- Web Design & Development: sites engineered to rank and convert, built from the owner's real voice.
- Paid Ads: Google Ads and Local Services Ads, coordinated with organic.
